---
description: Quick reference for ponytail levels, skills, and commands
---

Show Ponytail quick reference. One shot, change nothing. Levels: /ponytail lite (build asked work; name lazier alternative), /ponytail (full default), /ponytail ultra (deletion first), /ponytail off (disable current session). Six skills and commands: /ponytail (lazy mode), /ponytail-review (diff over-engineering review), /ponytail-audit (whole-repo audit), /ponytail-debt (shortcut ledger), /ponytail-gain (published benchmark card), /ponytail-help (this card). OpenCode starts each session in full. Mode changes stay in current session and write no global mode file. Deactivate with 'stop ponytail' or 'normal mode'.
